svg.title: Judging success, README version: one task meets the bar, one does not
svg.desc: Dot plots on blind 60-episode test sets with the scale-up quality bar drawn in. Plates: release-anchored review reaches balanced accuracy 0.936 (LEVI from segments 0.808, a direct call 0.782) and judges 12.8% of failures as successes (38.5%, 43.6%); both meet the bar of 0.90 and 15%. Screws: 0.756 and 48.7%, both miss it. The full version is figure 7 in the architecture atlas.
